triggers.definition: CREATE TRIGGER protect_order_financial_columns_trigger BEFORE UPDATE OF commission_amount, gst_amount, rider_earning, commission_percentage, gst_percentage, actual_fare, boost_rider_earning, boost_company_earning, payment_status, fare_payment_method, current_fare, final_fare, boost_amount, boost_percentage, pg_charge_amount ON public.orders FOR EACH ROW EXECUTE FUNCTION protect_order_financial_columns()
CREATE TRIGGER protect_order_state_columns_trigger BEFORE UPDATE OF order_status, pickup_otp, delivery_otp, rider_id ON public.orders FOR EACH ROW EXECUTE FUNCTION protect_order_state_columns()
CREATE TRIGGER trg_order_completion_side_effects AFTER UPDATE OF order_status ON public.orders FOR EACH ROW EXECUTE FUNCTION enqueue_order_completion_side_effects()
CREATE TRIGGER trg_orders_compliance_retention BEFORE UPDATE OF order_status ON public.orders FOR EACH ROW EXECUTE FUNCTION set_compliance_retention()
CREATE TRIGGER trg_populate_order_code BEFORE INSERT ON public.orders FOR EACH ROW EXECUTE FUNCTION trg_orders_order_code()

CREATE TRIGGER trigger_assign_nearby_orders_on_rider_freed AFTER UPDATE OF order_status ON public.orders FOR EACH ROW WHEN (((old.order_status = ANY (ARRAY['accepted'::order_status_enum, 'rider_arrived'::order_status_enum, 'picked_up'::order_status_enum, 'ongoing'::order_status_enum, 'payment_pending'::order_status_enum])) AND (new.order_status <> ALL (ARRAY['accepted'::order_status_enum, 'rider_arrived'::order_status_enum, 'picked_up'::order_status_enum, 'ongoing'::order_status_enum, 'payment_pending'::order_status_enum])) AND (new.rider_id IS NOT NULL))) EXECUTE FUNCTION assign_nearby_searching_orders_on_rider_freed()

CREATE TRIGGER trigger_assign_new_order_to_nearby_riders AFTER INSERT ON public.orders FOR EACH ROW WHEN ((new.order_status = 'searching'::order_status_enum)) EXECUTE FUNCTION assign_new_order_to_nearby_online_riders()
CREATE TRIGGER trigger_enforce_order_rider_service_mode BEFORE UPDATE OF rider_id ON public.orders FOR EACH ROW EXECUTE FUNCTION enforce_order_rider_service_mode()
CREATE TRIGGER trigger_order_status_update AFTER UPDATE OF order_status ON public.orders FOR EACH ROW EXECUTE FUNCTION on_order_status_update()
CREATE TRIGGER trigger_enforce_rider_assignment_service_mode BEFORE INSERT ON public.rider_assignments FOR EACH ROW EXECUTE FUNCTION enforce_rider_assignment_service_mode()
CREATE TRIGGER trigger_prevent_local_ride_assignment_to_busy_rider BEFORE INSERT OR UPDATE ON public.rider_assignments FOR EACH ROW EXECUTE FUNCTION prevent_local_ride_assignment_to_busy_rider()
CREATE TRIGGER trigger_rider_assignment_change AFTER INSERT OR UPDATE OF assignment_status ON public.rider_assignments FOR EACH ROW EXECUTE FUNCTION on_rider_assignment_change()
CREATE TRIGGER on_rider_status_change AFTER UPDATE OF account_status ON public.riders FOR EACH ROW EXECUTE FUNCTION handle_rider_status_change()
CREATE TRIGGER protect_rider_financial_columns_trigger BEFORE UPDATE ON public.riders FOR EACH ROW EXECUTE FUNCTION protect_rider_financial_columns()

CREATE TRIGGER trg_riders_gps_bridge_to_rider_locations AFTER UPDATE OF current_lat, current_lng ON public.riders FOR EACH ROW WHEN (((old.current_lat IS DISTINCT FROM new.current_lat) OR (old.current_lng IS DISTINCT FROM new.current_lng) OR (old.current_heading IS DISTINCT FROM new.current_heading) OR (old.last_location_updated_at IS DISTINCT FROM new.last_location_updated_at) OR (old.last_active_at IS DISTINCT FROM new.last_active_at))) EXECUTE FUNCTION sync_riders_gps_to_rider_locations()

CREATE TRIGGER trigger_assign_nearby_orders AFTER UPDATE OF account_status ON public.riders FOR EACH ROW WHEN (((new.account_status = 'online'::rider_account_status_enum) AND (old.account_status IS DISTINCT FROM 'online'::rider_account_status_enum))) EXECUTE FUNCTION assign_nearby_searching_orders_to_rider()
CREATE TRIGGER trigger_prevent_service_mode_switch_during_active_order BEFORE UPDATE OF service_mode ON public.riders FOR EACH ROW EXECUTE FUNCTION prevent_service_mode_switch_during_active_order()
CREATE TRIGGER trigger_rider_wallet_balance_update AFTER UPDATE OF wallet_balance ON public.riders FOR EACH ROW EXECUTE FUNCTION on_rider_wallet_balance_update()

functions.name: assign_nearby_searching_orders_core
functions.definition:
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.assign_nearby_searching_orders_core(p_rider_id uuid, p_rider_user_id uuid, p_current_lat double precision, p_current_lng double precision, p_service_mode partner_service_mode_enum)
 RETURNS void
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'public'
AS $function$
DECLARE
    v_order RECORD;
    v_radius_km double precision;
    v_stale_sec integer;
    v_dist_km double precision;
    v_timeout_sec integer;
    v_max_search_duration_sec integer;
    v_existing_id uuid;
    v_existing_status text;
    v_rider_vehicle text;
BEGIN
    IF p_current_lat IS NULL OR p_current_lng IS NULL THEN
        RETURN;
    END IF;

    -- GOVERNMENT TAX DUE: a blocked rider receives no new assignments through this path either.
    IF public.is_rider_blocked_by_tax_due(p_rider_id) THEN
        RETURN;
    END IF;

    -- COD LIMIT: a rider whose cash-on-delivery pending amount has reached their configured limit
    -- receives no new assignments through this path either, until they settle.
    IF public.is_rider_blocked_by_cod_limit(p_rider_id) THEN
        RETURN;
    END IF;

    SELECT
        COALESCE(round_2_radius_km, 5.0),
        COALESCE(rider_location_stale_sec, 60),
        COALESCE(rider_response_timeout_sec, 120),
        COALESCE(max_search_duration_sec, 900)
    INTO
        v_radius_km,
        v_stale_sec,
        v_timeout_sec,
        v_max_search_duration_sec
    FROM public.dispatch_config
    WHERE is_active = true
    LIMIT 1;

    v_radius_km := COALESCE(v_radius_km, 5.0);
    v_stale_sec := COALESCE(v_stale_sec, 60);
    v_timeout_sec := COALESCE(v_timeout_sec, 120);
    v_max_search_duration_sec := COALESCE(v_max_search_duration_sec, 900);

    SELECT COALESCE(rk.vehicle_type::text, '') INTO v_rider_vehicle
    FROM public.rider_kyc rk
    WHERE rk.user_id = p_rider_user_id
    LIMIT 1;

    FOR v_order IN (
        SELECT
            o.id,
            o.pickup_lat,
            o.pickup_lng,
            o.vehicle_type::text AS vehicle_type,
            o.order_type::text AS order_type,
            o.rider_earning,
            o.distance_meters,
            COALESCE(
                o.actual_weight_kg,
                COALESCE(NULLIF(regexp_replace(o.weight_category::text, '[^0-9.]', '', 'g'), ''), '0')::double precision
            )::double precision AS weight_kg
        FROM public.orders o
        WHERE o.order_status = 'searching'
          AND o.user_id != p_rider_user_id
          -- STALENESS GUARD: never a candidate for (re-)offering once the order has been searching
          -- longer than the platform's configured search lifetime.
          AND o.created_at >= (NOW() - (v_max_search_duration_sec || ' seconds')::interval)
    ) LOOP
        v_dist_km := 6371 * acos(
            LEAST(GREATEST(
                cos(radians(v_order.pickup_lat))
                * cos(radians(p_current_lat))
                * cos(
                    radians(p_current_lng)
                    - radians(v_order.pickup_lng)
                )
                + sin(radians(v_order.pickup_lat))
                * sin(radians(p_current_lat))
            , -1.0), 1.0)
        );

        IF v_dist_km <= v_radius_km
           AND public.get_required_service_mode(v_order.order_type, v_order.distance_meters) = p_service_mode
           AND (
            ((v_order.order_type = 'ride' OR v_order.order_type = 'intercity_ride' OR v_order.order_type = 'intercity') AND
             v_rider_vehicle = v_order.vehicle_type)
            OR
            (v_order.order_type = 'ride_sharing' AND v_rider_vehicle IN ('auto', 'cab'))
            OR
            (
                (v_order.order_type = 'local_parcel' OR v_order.order_type LIKE '%parcel%' OR v_order.order_type LIKE '%delivery%')
                AND v_order.order_type != 'intercity_parcel'
                AND
                (
                    (v_order.weight_kg < 10.0 AND v_rider_vehicle = 'bike')
                    OR
                    (v_order.weight_kg >= 10.0 AND v_rider_vehicle = 'auto')
                )
            )
            OR
            (
                v_order.order_type = 'intercity_parcel'
                AND
                (
                    (v_order.weight_kg < 10.0 AND v_rider_vehicle = 'bike')
                    OR
                    (v_order.weight_kg >= 10.0 AND v_rider_vehicle IN ('auto', 'cab'))
                )
            )
            OR
            (v_order.order_type NOT IN ('ride', 'intercity_ride', 'intercity', 'ride_sharing', 'local_parcel', 'intercity_parcel') AND v_order.order_type NOT LIKE '%parcel%' AND v_order.order_type NOT LIKE '%delivery%')
        ) THEN
            v_existing_id := NULL;
            v_existing_status := NULL;

            SELECT id, assignment_status INTO v_existing_id, v_existing_status
            FROM public.rider_assignments
            WHERE order_id = v_order.id
              AND rider_id = p_rider_id
            LIMIT 1;

            BEGIN
                IF v_existing_id IS NULL THEN
                    INSERT INTO public.rider_assignments (
                        order_id,
                        rider_id,
                        assignment_round,
                        assignment_status,
                        distance_km,
                        estimated_earnings,
                        sent_at,
                        expires_at,
                        last_seen_at,
                        last_seen_fare
                    ) VALUES (
                        v_order.id,
                        p_rider_id,
                        1,
                        'sent',
                        v_dist_km,
                        v_order.rider_earning,
                        NOW(),
                        NOW() + (v_timeout_sec || ' seconds')::interval,
                        NOW(),
                        v_order.rider_earning
                    );

                    -- FIX: audit-log write isolated into its own sub-transaction -- a duplicate
                    -- (order_id, rider_id, assignment_round) row here (assignment_round is always 1
                    -- for this dispatch path) must never undo the rider_assignments INSERT above,
                    -- which is the actual source of truth for what the rider sees.
                    BEGIN
                        INSERT INTO public.order_assignment_logs (
                            order_id,
                            rider_id,
                            assignment_round,
                            assignment_status,
                            rider_distance_km,
                            estimated_pickup_time_min,
                            sent_at
                        ) VALUES (
                            v_order.id,
                            p_rider_id,
                            1,
                            'sent',
                            v_dist_km,
                            -- Reproduced verbatim from the live production definition (confirmed via
                            -- a read-only pg_dump audit against the linked project): the fresh-
                            -- insert branch has always written v_order.rider_earning into this
                            -- column here, not CEIL(v_dist_km * 3) like the two re-offer branches
                            -- below. Almost certainly a pre-existing, unrelated copy/paste quirk in
                            -- an inert, write-only audit-log column (order_assignment_logs.
                            -- estimated_pickup_time_min is never selected/read anywhere in the
                            -- Flutter client -- rider_orders_screen.dart only ever selects this
                            -- column from rider_assignments, which doesn't have it, and always
                            -- falls back to its own (distKm * 3).ceil() computation instead) -- but
                            -- correcting it is out of scope for this fix, so it is left exactly as
                            -- production already has it rather than silently changing it here.
                            v_order.rider_earning,
                            NOW()
                        );
                    EXCEPTION WHEN OTHERS THEN
                        NULL;
                    END;
                ELSIF v_existing_status = 'expired' THEN
                    IF EXISTS (
                        SELECT 1 FROM public.rider_assignments
                        WHERE id = v_existing_id
                          AND v_order.rider_earning > COALESCE(last_seen_fare, estimated_earnings, 0)
                    ) THEN
                        UPDATE public.rider_assignments
                        SET
                            assignment_status = 'sent',
                            distance_km = v_dist_km,
                            sent_at = NOW(),
                            expires_at = NOW() + (v_timeout_sec || ' seconds')::interval,
                            updated_at = NOW(),
                            responded_at = NULL,
                            response_type = NULL,
                            hidden_until = NULL,
                            last_seen_at = NOW(),
                            last_seen_fare = v_order.rider_earning
                        WHERE id = v_existing_id;

                        -- FIX: see above -- isolated so a duplicate-round audit row can never roll
                        -- back the UPDATE that just re-sent this assignment to the rider.
                        BEGIN
                            INSERT INTO public.order_assignment_logs (
                                order_id,
                                rider_id,
                                assignment_round,
                                assignment_status,
                                rider_distance_km,
                                estimated_pickup_time_min,
                                sent_at
                            ) VALUES (
                                v_order.id,
                                p_rider_id,
                                1,
                                'sent',
                                v_dist_km,
                                CEIL(v_dist_km * 3),
                                NOW()
                            );
                        EXCEPTION WHEN OTHERS THEN
                            NULL;
                        END;
                    END IF;
                ELSIF v_existing_status = 'rejected' THEN
                    IF EXISTS (
                        SELECT 1 FROM public.rider_assignments
                        WHERE id = v_existing_id
                          AND NOW() >= COALESCE(hidden_until, NOW())
                          AND v_order.rider_earning > COALESCE(last_seen_fare, estimated_earnings, 0)
                    ) THEN
                        UPDATE public.rider_assignments
                        SET
                            assignment_status = 'sent',
                            distance_km = v_dist_km,
                            sent_at = NOW(),
                            expires_at = NOW() + (v_timeout_sec || ' seconds')::interval,
                            updated_at = NOW(),
                            responded_at = NULL,
                            response_type = NULL,
                            hidden_until = NULL,
                            last_seen_at = NOW(),
                            last_seen_fare = v_order.rider_earning
                        WHERE id = v_existing_id;

                        -- FIX: see above -- isolated so a duplicate-round audit row can never roll
                        -- back the UPDATE that just re-sent this assignment to the rider.
                        BEGIN
                            INSERT INTO public.order_assignment_logs (
                                order_id,
                                rider_id,
                                assignment_round,
                                assignment_status,
                                rider_distance_km,
                                estimated_pickup_time_min,
                                sent_at
                            ) VALUES (
                                v_order.id,
                                p_rider_id,
                                1,
                                'sent',
                                v_dist_km,
                                CEIL(v_dist_km * 3),
                                NOW()
                            );
                        EXCEPTION WHEN OTHERS THEN
                            NULL;
                        END;
                    END IF;
                END IF;
            EXCEPTION WHEN unique_violation THEN
                -- Retained: still catches a genuine concurrent-INSERT race on rider_assignments'
                -- own (order_id, rider_id) unique key (two rematch mechanisms firing at once for a
                -- pair that has never been offered before). The order_assignment_logs unique key can
                -- no longer reach this handler at all -- it is caught by its own inner block above.
                NULL;
            END;
        END IF;
    END LOOP;
END;
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.expire_stale_active_orders()
 RETURNS void
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'public'
AS $function$
DECLARE
    v_order RECORD;
    v_expired_count integer := 0;
BEGIN
    -- The CTE snapshots each candidate's PRE-update order_status (old_status) before the UPDATE
    -- overwrites it -- unlike expire_stale_searching_orders() (which can hardcode the literal
    -- 'searching' as previous_status, since its WHERE clause matches exactly one starting status),
    -- this sweep matches six different possible starting statuses, so the true prior value has to
    -- be captured explicitly to write a correct order_status_history row.
    FOR v_order IN
        WITH stale AS (
            SELECT id, order_status AS old_status
            FROM public.orders
            WHERE order_status IN ('accepted', 'rider_arrived', 'picked_up', 'ongoing', 'rider_at_drop', 'payment_pending')
              AND updated_at < (NOW() - INTERVAL '24 hours')
        )
        UPDATE public.orders o
        SET order_status = 'cancelled',
            cancel_reason = 'Automatically cancelled: no activity for 24+ hours',
            cancelled_at = NOW(),
            updated_at = NOW()
        FROM stale
        WHERE o.id = stale.id
        RETURNING o.id, stale.old_status
    LOOP
        v_expired_count := v_expired_count + 1;

        INSERT INTO public.order_status_history (order_id, previous_status, new_status, changed_by, notes)
        VALUES (
            v_order.id,
            v_order.old_status,
            'cancelled',
            'system',
            'Auto-cancelled: no activity for 24+ hours (stale active-order recovery).'
        );

        UPDATE public.rider_assignments
        SET assignment_status = 'expired',
            responded_at = NOW(),
            updated_at = NOW()
        WHERE order_id = v_order.id
          AND assignment_status IN ('sent', 'accepted');

        UPDATE public.order_assignment_logs
        SET assignment_status = 'expired',
            responded_at = NOW()
        WHERE order_id = v_order.id
          AND assignment_status IN ('sent', 'accepted');
    END LOOP;

    IF v_expired_count > 0 THEN
        RAISE LOG '[expire_stale_active_orders] Auto-cancelled % stale active order(s) past 24h with no activity.', v_expired_count;
    END IF;
END;
$function$

functions.name: expire_stale_searching_orders
functions.definition:
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.expire_stale_searching_orders()
 RETURNS void
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'public'
AS $function$
DECLARE
    v_max_search_duration_sec integer;
    v_order RECORD;
    v_expired_count integer := 0;
BEGIN
    SELECT COALESCE(max_search_duration_sec, 900)
    INTO v_max_search_duration_sec
    FROM public.dispatch_config
    WHERE is_active = true
    LIMIT 1;

    v_max_search_duration_sec := COALESCE(v_max_search_duration_sec, 900);

    FOR v_order IN
        UPDATE public.orders
        SET order_status = 'expired',
            updated_at = NOW()
        WHERE order_status = 'searching'
          AND order_type NOT IN ('intercity_ride', 'intercity_parcel')
          AND created_at < (NOW() - (v_max_search_duration_sec || ' seconds')::interval)
        RETURNING id
    LOOP
        v_expired_count := v_expired_count + 1;

        INSERT INTO public.order_status_history (order_id, previous_status, new_status, changed_by, notes)
        VALUES (
            v_order.id,
            'searching',
            'expired',
            'system',
            'Auto-expired: no rider accepted within the configured search window.'
        );

        -- Close out any outstanding 'sent' assignment for this order -- it is now moot, and must
        -- never be resettable back to 'sent' by assign_nearby_searching_orders_to_rider() (which is
        -- itself now guarded against this by the companion migration's created_at bound, but closing
        -- it here too keeps rider_assignments/order_assignment_logs consistent with the same
        -- cleanup update-order-status's 'cancelled' branch already performs for every other
        -- terminal-order-state transition).
        UPDATE public.rider_assignments
        SET assignment_status = 'expired',
            responded_at = NOW(),
            updated_at = NOW(),
            response_type = 'ignored'
        WHERE order_id = v_order.id
          AND assignment_status = 'sent';

        UPDATE public.order_assignment_logs
        SET assignment_status = 'expired',
            responded_at = NOW()
        WHERE order_id = v_order.id
          AND assignment_status = 'sent';
    END LOOP;

    IF v_expired_count > 0 THEN
        RAISE LOG '[expire_stale_searching_orders] Expired % order(s) past their % second search window.', v_expired_count, v_max_search_duration_sec;
    END IF;

    -- Independent safety net: expire any 'sent' rider_assignments whose OWN expires_at has passed,
    -- regardless of their order's status (covers assignments a dispatch worker or the client's local
    -- timer never got to close out, e.g. app backgrounded/killed mid-round). Bounded by
    -- idx_rider_assignments_sent_expires_at.
    UPDATE public.rider_assignments
    SET assignment_status = 'expired',
        responded_at = NOW(),
        updated_at = NOW(),
        response_type = 'ignored'
    WHERE assignment_status = 'sent'
      AND expires_at < NOW();
END;
$function$

functions.name: find_nearby_riders
functions.definition:
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.find_nearby_riders(p_order_id uuid, p_pickup_lat double precision, p_pickup_lng double precision, p_radius_km double precision, p_limit integer, p_excluded_rider_ids uuid[] DEFAULT '{}'::uuid[])
 RETURNS TABLE(rider_id uuid, user_id uuid, full_name text, vehicle_type text, vehicle_number text, current_lat double precision, current_lng double precision, distance_km numeric)
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'public'
AS $function$
DECLARE
    v_order_type text;
    v_vehicle_type text;
    v_stale_sec integer;
    v_creator_user_id uuid;
    v_weight_kg double precision;
    v_distance_meters integer;
    v_required_mode public.partner_service_mode_enum;
    v_tax_due_threshold numeric;
BEGIN
    SELECT
        o.order_type,
        o.vehicle_type,
        o.user_id,
        COALESCE(
            o.actual_weight_kg,
            COALESCE(NULLIF(regexp_replace(o.weight_category::text, '[^0-9.]', '', 'g'), ''), '0')::double precision
        )::double precision,
        o.distance_meters
    INTO
        v_order_type,
        v_vehicle_type,
        v_creator_user_id,
        v_weight_kg,
        v_distance_meters
    FROM orders o
    WHERE o.id = p_order_id;

    IF auth.uid() IS NOT NULL AND (v_creator_user_id IS NULL OR auth.uid() != v_creator_user_id) THEN
        RETURN;
    END IF;

    v_required_mode := public.get_required_service_mode(v_order_type, v_distance_meters);

    SELECT COALESCE(rider_location_stale_sec, 60)
    INTO v_stale_sec
    FROM dispatch_config
    WHERE is_active = true
    LIMIT 1;

    SELECT public.get_active_tax_due_threshold()
    INTO v_tax_due_threshold;

    RETURN QUERY
    WITH candidates AS (
        SELECT
            r.id AS rider_id,
            r.user_id,
            rk.full_name,
            rk.vehicle_type::text AS vehicle_type,
            rk.vehicle_number,
            r.current_lat,
            r.current_lng,
            (
                6371 * acos(
                    LEAST(GREATEST(
                        cos(radians(p_pickup_lat))
                        * cos(radians(r.current_lat))
                        * cos(
                            radians(r.current_lng)
                            - radians(p_pickup_lng)
                        )
                        + sin(radians(p_pickup_lat))
                        * sin(radians(r.current_lat))
                    , -1.0), 1.0)
                )
            ) AS raw_distance_km
        FROM riders r
        INNER JOIN rider_kyc rk
            ON rk.user_id = r.user_id
        WHERE
            r.account_status = 'online'
            AND r.service_mode = v_required_mode
            AND r.current_lat IS NOT NULL
            AND r.current_lng IS NOT NULL
            AND r.user_id != v_creator_user_id
            AND NOT (r.id = ANY(p_excluded_rider_ids))
            AND r.government_tax_due_balance < v_tax_due_threshold
            AND COALESCE(r.cod_pending_amount, 0) < COALESCE(r.cod_limit, 500)
            AND (rk.kyc_status::text IN ('approved', 'pending', 'under_review', 'resubmitted') OR rk.kyc_status IS NULL)
            AND (rk.activation_status::text IN ('active', 'pending', 'inactive') OR rk.activation_status IS NULL)
            AND (
                r.last_location_updated_at >= (NOW() - (v_stale_sec || ' seconds')::interval)
                OR
                r.last_location_updated_at >= (NOW() - INTERVAL '24 hours')
                OR
                r.last_location_updated_at IS NULL
            )
            AND (
                ((v_order_type = 'ride' OR v_order_type = 'intercity_ride' OR v_order_type = 'intercity') AND
                 rk.vehicle_type::text = v_vehicle_type)
                OR
                (v_order_type = 'ride_sharing' AND rk.vehicle_type::text IN ('auto', 'cab'))
                OR
                (
                    (v_order_type = 'local_parcel' OR v_order_type LIKE '%parcel%' OR v_order_type LIKE '%delivery%')
                    AND v_order_type != 'intercity_parcel'
                    AND
                    (
                        (v_weight_kg < 10.0 AND rk.vehicle_type::text = 'bike')
                        OR
                        (v_weight_kg >= 10.0 AND rk.vehicle_type::text = 'auto')
                    )
                )
                OR
                (
                    v_order_type = 'intercity_parcel'
                    AND
                    (
                        (v_weight_kg < 10.0 AND rk.vehicle_type::text = 'bike')
                        OR
                        (v_weight_kg >= 10.0 AND rk.vehicle_type::text IN ('auto', 'cab'))
                    )
                )
                OR
                (v_order_type NOT IN ('ride', 'intercity_ride', 'intercity', 'ride_sharing', 'local_parcel', 'intercity_parcel') AND v_order_type NOT LIKE '%parcel%' AND v_order_type NOT LIKE '%delivery%')
            )
            AND NOT public.rider_is_on_active_trip(r.id)
    )
    SELECT
        candidates.rider_id,
        candidates.user_id,
        candidates.full_name,
        candidates.vehicle_type,
        candidates.vehicle_number,
        candidates.current_lat,
        candidates.current_lng,
        ROUND(candidates.raw_distance_km::numeric, 2) AS distance_km
    FROM candidates
    WHERE candidates.raw_distance_km <= p_radius_km
    ORDER BY distance_km ASC
    LIMIT p_limit;
END;
$function$

functions.name: redispatch_freed_riders
functions.definition:
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.redispatch_freed_riders()
 RETURNS void
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'public'
AS $function$
DECLARE
    v_rider RECORD;
BEGIN
    IF NOT pg_try_advisory_xact_lock(4735021, 1) THEN
        RAISE NOTICE 'redispatch_freed_riders: previous sweep still running -- skipping this tick.';
        RETURN;
    END IF;

    FOR v_rider IN (
        SELECT r.id, r.user_id, r.current_lat, r.current_lng, r.service_mode
        FROM public.riders r
        WHERE r.account_status = 'online'
          AND r.current_lat IS NOT NULL
          AND r.current_lng IS NOT NULL
          AND EXISTS (
              SELECT 1 FROM public.orders o
              WHERE o.rider_id = r.id
                AND o.updated_at >= NOW() - INTERVAL '5 minutes'
          )
          AND NOT EXISTS (
              SELECT 1 FROM public.orders bo
              WHERE bo.rider_id = r.id
                AND bo.order_status IN ('accepted', 'rider_arrived', 'picked_up', 'rider_at_drop', 'ongoing', 'payment_pending')
          )
    ) LOOP
        BEGIN
            PERFORM public.assign_nearby_searching_orders_core(
                v_rider.id,
                v_rider.user_id,
                v_rider.current_lat,
                v_rider.current_lng,
                v_rider.service_mode
            );
        EXCEPTION WHEN OTHERS THEN
            RAISE WARNING 'redispatch_freed_riders: failed to rematch rider %: %', v_rider.id, SQLERRM;
        END;
    END LOOP;
END;
$function$

rider_self_rematch
functions.definition:
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.rider_self_rematch()
 RETURNS void
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'public'
AS $function$
DECLARE
    v_rider RECORD;
BEGIN
    SELECT id, user_id, current_lat, current_lng, service_mode
    INTO v_rider
    FROM public.riders
    WHERE user_id = auth.uid();

    IF NOT FOUND THEN
        RETURN;
    END IF;

    PERFORM public.assign_nearby_searching_orders_core(
        v_rider.id,
        v_rider.user_id,
        v_rider.current_lat,
        v_rider.current_lng,
        v_rider.service_mode
    );
END;
$function$
